extraction_notes: The PDF identifies the device as a silicon PNP transistor in a SOT-23 plastic package, complementary to 8050M, with pin 1 = base, pin 2 = emitter, and pin 3 = collector. The requested MPN 8550M-D is the D hFE classification variant; p. 1 lists D marking HY2D and hFE range 160-300, while the p. 2 electrical table is headed for 8550M generally.

All p. 2 electrical-characteristics values were transcribed with Ta = 25 degC and the datasheet's negative PNP polarity. Minimum, typical, and maximum meanings are preserved in source_kind; no guaranteed bounds were converted to typical values.

Curve points were digitized from a 300 dpi raster of p. 3 by pixel measurement against the printed axis gridlines. The PNP plots display positive magnitudes, so curve axes and conditions explicitly identify magnitudes; curve values are not signed terminal voltages or currents.

The p. 3 IC - VCE plot's y-axis is labeled IC (mA) with a 0 to 0.5 span, but with IB = 0.5 to 3.0 mA that reading would imply hFE below 0.2. The span is interpreted as amperes (0 to 0.5 A), which agrees with the table hFE and the hFE - IC plot; this axis-label discrepancy is flagged rather than silently ignored.

The digitized fT - IC curve peaks near 202 MHz at |IC| = 50 mA, matching the p. 2 table typical fT of 200 MHz at VCE = -10 V, IC = -50 mA, which corroborates the curve calibration. ft stores the guaranteed minimum of 100 MHz because the strict schema has only one ft object; the typical value is preserved here.

The p. 2 table gives VBE typ = -0.66 V and max = -1.0 V at VCE = -1.0 V and IC = -10 mA; the strict schema has no dedicated VBE(on) field, so this permitted table fact is recorded here rather than omitted silently.

The p. 2 table gives VCBO minimum = -40 V at IC = -0.1 mA, IE = 0; VEBO minimum = -6.0 V at IE = -0.1 mA, IC = 0; ICBO maximum = -0.1 uA at VCB = -35 V, IE = 0; and IEBO maximum = -0.1 uA at VEB = -6.0 V, IC = 0. These have no dedicated fields in the strict schema.

Absolute maximum ratings on p. 2: VCBO -40 V, VCEO -25 V, VEBO -6.0 V, IC -1.5 A, IB -0.5 A, PC 300 mW, Tj 150 degC, Tstg -55 to 150 degC. The p. 3 PC - Ta derating plot is included as drawn; its measured flat level of about 620 mW at Ta <= 25 degC conflicts with the 300 mW table rating, and the table rating should not be replaced by the plotted curve.
No cibo/input-capacitance value is published in the supplied datasheet, so cibo is null.
